“深圳的九州创投？”

张立恒重复了一遍这句话，声音压低了半度，像是怕自己听错。

王志远笑容还挂在嘴角，但那弧度已经冻住了。

他的视线从苏晚棠脸上滑到林川身上，嘴唇微微张开，又合上。

招商主管小赵端茶的手缓缓放了下来。

他刚才还觉得这个年轻人是苏晚棠的跟班，现在那杯茶的角度自动偏转了四十五度——朝着林川的方向。

苏晚棠没有多说一个字。

张立恒转过身，重新看向林川。

九州创投。

中科创业一役，五千万本金砸进去，一亿八出来。

这个名字最近在深圳证券圈子里，几乎是带血腥味的。

而站在自己面前的这个人，年轻得不像话。

张立恒往前走了一步，伸出手。

“林总，是我眼拙了。”

语气彻底变了。不是刚才那种对着“小苏带来的客人”的客套，而是带分量的、正式的尊重。

林川和他握了一下，没用力，嘴角带着点笑意。

“张总客气了。”

王志远这时候还站在沙盘旁边，手指还搭在自己那份PPT方案的封面上。

他的表情像刚咽下一口凉了的茶，不上不下。

“九州创投我倒是有耳闻。”他笑了笑，把方案往前推了推，语气里还残留着一层不甘心，

“不过做资本和做园区，毕竟是两回事。张总，我那套方案——”

“老王。”

张立恒抬了一下手，笑容很温和，但声音却是变得生硬了些。

“你那边的东西，回头我再细看。我现在想先跟林总聊聊。”

王志远的脸，肉眼可见地僵了一下。

他手里那份做了三天的方案，刚放到沙盘上不到五分钟，就被主人推到了一边。

小赵已经开始识趣地往办公室方向走，推开门，回头看了一眼张立恒。

“张总，里边请？”

张立恒侧过身，手臂微微抬起，做了个极标准的“请”的动作。

不是对着苏晚棠，也不是对着王志远。

是对着林川。

“林总，里面坐。”

林川点了一下头，迈步走了过去。

苏晚棠跟在半步后面，手里抱着文件夹，表情没什么变化，

但走过王志远身边的时候，她的高跟鞋敲得格外清脆。

王志远站在原地，没人请他进去。

他低头看了一眼自己那份方案，上面“年租金收益提升40%”几个字印得很大。

此刻这些字看起来像笑话。

张立恒的办公室在展示中心二楼。

秘书泡了两杯龙井，放在林川和张立恒面前。

张立恒坐下来，没急着说客套话。他双手交叉放在桌上，盯着林川的眼睛。

“林总，你刚才在楼下那句话——说我做的不是产业园，是写字楼。”

他顿了一下，喉结滚了一下。

“Jiuzhou Venture Capital in Shenzhen?”

Zhang Liheng repeated this sentence, lowering his voice by half a degree, as if he was afraid that he heard wrongly.

Wang Zhiyuan's smile was still hanging on the corner of his mouth, but the arc was frozen.

His eyes slid from Su Wantang's face to Lin Chuan, his lips opened slightly and then closed again.

Xiao Zhao, the investment director, slowly lowered his hand holding the tea.

Just now, he thought that this young man was Su Wantang's follower, but now the angle of the cup of tea automatically deflected by 45 degrees - towards Lin Chuan.

Su Wantang didn't say a word more.

Zhang Liheng turned around and looked at Lin Chuan again.

Jiuzhou Venture Capital.

In the Zhongke Entrepreneurship Campaign, 50 million principal was invested and 180 million came out.

This name is almost bloody in Shenzhen securities circles recently.

And the man standing in front of him was incredibly young.

Zhang Liheng took a step forward and stretched out his hand.

"Mr. Lin, I'm blind."

The tone completely changed.It's not the polite way you treated "the guests brought by Xiao Su" just now, but a serious and formal respect.

Lin Chuan shook his hand without any force, with a slight smile on his lips.

"Mr. Zhang, you're welcome."

Wang Zhiyuan was still standing next to the sand table at this time, with his fingers still on the cover of his PPT plan.

His expression looked like he had just swallowed a sip of cold tea, neither up nor down.

"I have heard about Jiuzhou Venture Capital." He smiled and pushed the plan forward, with a layer of reluctance still remaining in his tone.

"But doing capital and building a park are two different things after all. Mr. Zhang, my plan -"

"Old Wang."

Zhang Liheng raised his hand, his smile was gentle, but his voice became stiffer.

"I'll take a closer look at your stuff over there later. I want to talk to Mr. Lin now."

Wang Zhiyuan's face stiffened visibly.

The three-day plan in his hand was pushed aside by the owner within five minutes of putting it on the sand table.

Xiao Zhao had already begun to walk towards the office in an intelligent manner, opened the door, and looked back at Zhang Liheng.

"Mr. Zhang, please come inside?"

Zhang Liheng turned sideways, raised his arms slightly, and made a very standard "please" gesture.

Not to Su Wantang, nor to Wang Zhiyuan.

It was facing Lin Chuan.

"Mr. Lin, sit inside."

Lin Chuan nodded and walked over.

Su Wantang followed half a step behind, holding the folder in his hand, his expression unchanged.

But when she walked past Wang Zhiyuan, her high heels clicked particularly crisply.

Wang Zhiyuan stood there, no one invited him in.

He lowered his head and glanced at his plan. The words "Annual rental income increased by 40%" were printed large on it.

The words seemed like a joke at the moment.

Zhang Liheng's office is on the second floor of the exhibition center.

The secretary brewed two cups of Longjing and placed them in front of Lin Chuan and Zhang Liheng.

Zhang Liheng sat down and was not in a hurry to say polite words.He crossed his hands on the table and stared into Lin Chuan's eyes.

"Mr. Lin, what you said downstairs just now - you said that what I build is not an industrial park, but an office building."

He paused and his Adam's apple rolled.
